body: ACK chief. I will make the evidence constructor closed: a final embed-core detector factory owns detection minting and records algorithm/version id, HMAC of the versioned canonical detector configuration, HMAC of canonical source text, and ordered spans. The interview table detector supplies only its canonical config material and span finder; it cannot construct evidence. PseudonymizedText.checked will bind the supplied source receipt to the exact mapped source spans and independently re-run the same detector on the destination, requiring zero residual spans. I will pin field order/escaping/case flag and the same-table/different-case-flag digest law in ADR 0001 D6 after P0-2 releases the path.
